name: Jet Boarding Experience
description: Exhilarating ride on a Radinn X Sport Jet board. Includes helmet, impact vest, safety briefing, and instructor.

name: Mosselbay Spring Market
description: Local crafts, food stalls, and live music to celebrate the season.

name: December Beach Party
description: Start the December holidays with our annual beach party featuring local DJs.

name: Diaz Waterpark Family Day
description: Fun in the sun with indoor and outdoor heated pools and supertubes.

name: Garden Route Wedding Expo
description: The premier wedding exhibition in the Garden Route showcasing top local venues, photographers, and bridal vendors.

name: kykNET Buite Ekspo Suid-Kaap
description: A massive outdoor and camping exhibition featuring the latest 4x4 gear, caravans, and outdoor lifestyle products.

name: Mossel Bay Sports Festival Run
description: Community 15km road race and 4km fun run promoting inclusive coastal running along the beautiful Hartenbos coastline.

name: Christmas Fest Mossel Bay
description: Get a head start on the festive season with this early Christmas market featuring local food, crafts, and family entertainment.

name: Matriekbaai 2026
description: The ultimate matric holiday festival in the Southern Cape. Join thousands of matrics for beach parties, live DJs, and massive stage productions.

name: New Year's Eve: Appel Live
description: Ring in 2027 with popular South African artist Appel performing live at the iconic Hartenbos Amphitheatre.

name: Redberry Farm Strawberry Picking
description: A perfect family day out! Pick your own fresh strawberries, conquer the largest permanent hedge maze in the Southern Hemisphere, and enjoy artisan eateries.

name: George Lights Festival
description: The annual switching on of the Christmas lights! A massive street festival featuring local vendors, live music, kids entertainment, and a festive parade.

name: Outeniqua Family Market
description: The Garden Route's premier weekend market. Over 150 food and craft stalls, live local music, and plenty of seating under the trees.

name: Botlierskop Guided Safari
description: Experience the ultimate Garden Route safari. Spot rhinos, lions, buffalo, giraffes, and elephants on a pristine 4,200-hectare private game reserve.

name: ATKV Kersfees Mark
description: A massive festive holiday market featuring handmade gifts, traditional South African bakes, boerewors rolls, and a festive holiday atmosphere right by the beach.

name: Mossel Bay Zipline
description: Experience the longest over-ocean zipline in the world, spanning approximately 1.1km. Glide over the ocean and enjoy breathtaking views of the cliffs and bay.

name: RomONza Boat Trips to Seal Island
description: Take a scenic boat trip around Seal Island, home to thousands of Cape Fur Seals. Great for family outings and marine photography.

name: Bartolomeu Dias Museum Complex
description: Explore the Maritime Museum featuring a life-size replica of the Dias Caravel, visit the historic Post Office Tree, and stroll through the botanical gardens.

name: White Shark Africa Cage Diving
description: Get up close and personal with Great White Sharks in their natural habitat. A thrilling, safe, and educational marine experience.

name: Point of Human Origins Tour
description: Journey back in time with a guided tour of the Pinnacle Point caves, revealing some of the earliest evidence for modern human behavior.

name: Skydive Mossel Bay
description: Experience the ultimate adrenaline rush with a tandem skydive offering the best scenery in South Africa. Jump over the Indian Ocean and land right on the beach!

name: Dragon Dune Sandboarding
description: Tackle the longest sandboard ride in South Africa! The famous 'Dragon Dune' is a beast of a dune offering an exhilarating 320m ride.

name: Cape St Blaize Lighthouse Walk
description: A stunning 13.5km coastal hiking trail starting at the historic St Blaize Cave. Walk along the dramatic cliff edge offering incredible whale and dolphin watching spots.

name: Diaz Express Train Ride
description: A fun family excursion on a refurbished tractor-train running along the Transnet railway line between Mossel Bay and Great Brak River right next to the ocean.

name: Pinnacle Point Golf Course
description: Voted South Africa's Best Golf Course. An incredibly dramatic clifftop championship course offering ocean views from every single hole.

name: Cango Caves Heritage Tour
description: A must-do day trip from Mossel Bay! Explore the spectacular underground limestone caverns. Choose the Heritage Tour for an easy walk or the Adventure Tour for tight squeezes.

name: Mossel Bay Helicopters
description: See the Garden Route from above! Mossel Bay Helicopters offers scenic coastal flights, mountain drops, and dedicated shark viewing flights.

name: Map of Africa Viewpoint
description: A breathtaking viewpoint in Wilderness where the Kaaimans River curves around a forested hill, perfectly forming the shape of the African continent.

name: Wilderness River Safari
description: Rent a canoe and paddle up the Touw River to the Wilderness waterfall. A peaceful, stunning journey through indigenous forests.

name: Cango Wildlife Ranch
description: Encounter cheetahs, crocodiles, and lemurs. A highly ethical conservation facility offering guided tours and unique animal encounters.

name: ReedValley Wine Estate Concert
description: Live music event in the massive rustic barn at ReedValley. Enjoy premium Eden Valley wines and authentic Portuguese cuisine while you dance the night away.

name: Hartenbos Waterpark Splash Fest
description: A massive summer holiday bash at the Hartenbos Waterpark with live DJs, slip-and-slide competitions, and food stalls.

name: Great Brak Grab-a-Camp Weekend
description: A massive family camping weekend on the banks of the Great Brak River. Includes kayaking, fishing competitions, and a massive communal potjiekos competition.

name: Garden Route Casino Live Shows
description: Try your luck at the slots and tables, or catch top-tier South African comedians and musicians at the Bravo Lounge.

name: Oyster Bay Reserve Trail Run
description: A beautiful and challenging community trail run through the fynbos reserves of Mossel Bay, ending with a beach cleanup initiative.

name: Redberry Farm Market
description: Family fun market featuring local gifts, sweet treats, clothing, and face painting. Enjoy live music by Cole Nicholson, Janine Fourie, Glenwood, and Skye. Attractions include a Play Park with jumping castles and target shooting, as well as Luna & Co natural pet treats.

name: Anvie Ventures Weekend & Holiday Break-aways
description: More than 50 venues to choose from including lodges, bush camps, cottages, camp sites, tented camps, pet-friendly venues, and group camp venues. Activities include 40+ hiking trails, mountain biking, horse riding, canoeing, fishing, and abseiling.

name: 75 Years of VW: A Carnival of Memories
description: Come and display your new or vintage VW to celebrate 75 years. The event features a kids area, food & drinks, a photo booth, and various new & vintage VWs on display.

name: Move for a Cause: Support Breast Cancer
description: Join hundreds for a wellness experience supporting Breast Cancer, open to beginners, seasoned pros, and relay teams. Entry includes a Kauai smoothie and snack, plus a chance to win a 2-night stay at Gonnakraal Eco Cabin worth R3500.

name: Francois Boyce: Die Wildtuin & Ek
description: Lag, dans & dink with Francois Boyce. Bring your own picnic basket. Tickets available by contacting Cindy.

name: Singing Afternoon / Sang Middag
description: Hosted by the Garden Route Community Service Centre. Come and enjoy an afternoon filled with song and friendship! (English version poster of the earlier listed 'Sang Middag').

name: Murder Mystery Game Night at Lookout Deck
description: Someone's Guilty... Can You Crack the Case? The Lookout Deck in Plettenberg Bay is turning into a crime scene for one unforgettable Murder Mystery Game Night! Gather your sharpest friends, follow the clues, interrogate suspects, and dress the part—there is a special prize for Best Dressed Detective.

name: Bitou Birding Festival 2026
location: Bitou Estuaries, Nature's Valley & Plettenberg Bay
description: Slow Down, Look Up, Reconnect! The Bitou Birding Festival celebrates the extraordinary avian biodiversity of Plettenberg Bay and Nature's Valley across forests, fynbos, wetlands, and estuaries. Enjoy guided bird walks with top experts, canoe and boat excursions, a pelagic seabird expedition, and evening conservation talks.

name: The Rivertones: Rainbow Reggae Live at ReedValley
description: United in Rhythm! Join Cape Town's legendary reggae band The Rivertones at ReedValley Wine Estate for an electrifying tribute to Bob Marley, UB40, and Eddy Grant. Expect infectious island grooves, estate wines, delicious Portuguese-inspired dining, and a packed dancefloor.

name: UNSHAKABLE: Ladies' Gathering & Creative Workshop
time: Fri 6:00 PM - 9:00 PM & Sat 9:00 AM - 4:00 PM

priceDetails.cost: Hands-on Art Workshop, Course Notes, Sat Lunch, Snacks & Coffee

description: A two-day women's gathering in Sedgefield designed to inspire, restore, and connect. Your R250 ticket includes a hands-on creative art workshop, course notes, Saturday lunch, snacks, and tea & coffee throughout the weekend.

name: Tuiniqua Basaar 2026
vibe: Markets & Community, Food & Drink, Family & Kids
description: Traditional Garden Route bazaar hospitality at Tuiniqua in George! Stock up on home-baked pannekoek, poeding, koek & terte, kerrie & rys, vetkoek, worsrolle, homemade ginger beer, fresh farm produce, plants, arts & crafts, and treasures at the Wit Olifant (White Elephant) table. Card and cash facilities available.

name: Volkome Vrou / Voelgoedvrou met Andriëtte Norman
description: 'n Spesiale oggend vol inspirasie, lag, stories en bederf saam met geliefde sangeres Andriëtte Norman by The Bioscope Venue in Groot-Brakrivier. Geniet pragtige lewendige musiek, pop-up stalletjies, en 'n ligte ete met drankies ingesluit.

name: GLOW Skate Party at Rollercade George
description: The lights are going down and the neon is turning up! Dress in your brightest neon, retro, or glowing gear for a chance to win awesome prizes at Rollercade George. Four 2-hour sessions throughout Saturday, including a special evening session for teens and adults.

name: Pumpkins, Bats & Ghosts Family Fun Fair
vibe: Family & Kids, Markets & Community, Live Music & Entertainment
description: Halloween for a great cause in Mossel Bay! Hosted at Diaz Primary School to raise funds for animal sterilisation in informal settlements (Whispering with Dogs & Donation Angel Foundation). Features a Pumpkin Patch, Jumping Castles, Haunting House, Carnival Games, Live Music, and family picnic vibes. Pre-booking via WhatsApp essential.

name: The Bassline Society: Trick or Treat Vinyl House Night
description: Halloween gets an authentic vinyl house soundtrack at Backline Lounge Bar in Wilderness! Featuring all-vinyl sets by Wendy, Stereo Fiction, Matthew David, and Craig Horn. Prizes for best-dressed Halloween outfits.

name: Misty Valley Farm Dance with Rachus Muller
description: Put on your dancing boots for a lively Saturday night Farm Dance at Misty Valley Farm Venue featuring live music by Rachus Muller! Great country hospitality, hearty food, and sokkie under the fairy lights.

name: Mysteries, Mayhem, Crimes & Ghosts of Mossel Bay (Night Walk)

priceDetails.cost: Not suitable for small children or the faint of heart

location: Historic Town Centre & Cape St Blaize Precinct
description: As night falls on Halloween, discover the shadowy side of Mossel Bay where history, mystery, shipwrecks, crimes, and eerie untold ghost stories come to life on a guided lantern walk. Not suitable for small children or the faint of heart! Pre-booking via WhatsApp essential.

name: The Sunday Social Market at Trail Kiosk
vibe: Markets & Community, Food & Drink, Family & Kids
audience: All Ages, Family, Trail Runners & Cyclists
description: Relax under the trees at Trail Kiosk on Arbour Road in George for The Sunday Social Market (held on the first Sunday of the month: 1 Nov, 6 Dec & 3 Jan). Browse artisanal stalls including Root & Relish homemade chilli relishes, sip specialty coffee after your forest trail walk, and let the kids enjoy the jumping castle.

name: Donkey Forest Walks Car Boot Sale & Rescue Farm Day
vibe: Markets & Community, Nature & Wildlife, Family & Kids

priceDetails.cost: Bring your own carrots for the donkeys!

description: Animal Welfare, People & Community! Join Donkey Forest Walks at 245 Whites Road in Wilderness Heights for a special Car Boot Sale and farm open day. Browse farm milk, cheese & dairy, clothes, bangles & earrings, and homemade food & drinks. Pet and hold the lambs, feed the rescue donkeys (bring your own carrots!), and meet the farm cows, sheep, and goats.

name: Hart & Bosch Village Markaand (Night Market)
vibe: Markets & Community, Food & Drink, Family & Kids

priceDetails.cost: 40+ Stalls, Play Haus Kids Area & Big Screen Rugby

description: Kom kuier saam by Hart & Bosch Village se gesellige Markaand! Snuffel tussen meer as 40 stalletjies met wood-fired pizzas, pasteie, wraps, gevulde pannekoeke, bubble waffles, milkshakes en biltong. Die kinders kan veilig speel by die Play Haus terwyl grootmense na grootskerm-rugby by Glenhoff Brauhaus kyk.

name: Grootbrakmark (Great Brak First Saturday Market)
vibe: Markets & Community, Food & Drink, Arts & Culture
description: Spend a relaxed Saturday morning in the heart of Great Brak River at the beloved Grootbrakmark! Discover handmade coastal crafts, home-baked treats, local preserves, plants, clothing, and friendly village hospitality.

name: Eden Fest: Spinning Edition & Show and Shine Car Show
description: High-octane motorsport action comes to Die Gat in Mossel Bay! Eden Fest Spinning Edition features extreme tyre-smoking spinning stunts, a Show & Shine custom car showcase, sound-off exhibition, Monster activation, food court, and a spin-car giveaway.

name: Boma Market & Suid Kaap Bye Conservation Day at ReedValley
vibe: Markets & Community, Nature & Wildlife, Family & Kids

priceDetails.cost: 50+ Local Vendors, Raw Honey, Bee Seminar & Kids Scavenger Hunt

description: A massive family celebration at ReedValley Wine Farm! Browse 50+ local market stalls (including laser-cut crafts, raw honey from Southern Cape beekeepers, and gourmet food), attend the bee conservation seminar with guest speaker Ruan Veldtman, and enjoy live music, face painting, a kids scavenger hunt, and jumping castles.

name: Jakkie Louw Live at "Korf tot Kole" (ReedValley)
description: Presented by the Suid Kaap Byebedryf Vereniging (SKBBV) in support of local bee farmers! Join Afrikaans music favourite Jakkie Louw at ReedValley for an unforgettable "Korf tot Kole" evening of storytelling, hit songs, and a hearty farm dinner included in your ticket.

name: Holistic Expo Plett & Rainbow Fun Run
description: Two uplifting days of health, mindfulness, natural products, holistic therapies, and conscious living at Piesang Valley Community Hall in Plettenberg Bay, plus the colourful Rainbow Fun Run on Sunday 8 November.

name: Showground Sundays Market at George Showgrounds
vibe: Markets & Community, Food & Drink, Family & Kids
description: Local People, Local Products, Stronger Together! Held every second Sunday at the George Showgrounds, Showground Sundays brings together local makers, food trucks, plants & crafts, live music, and family-friendly fun under the Outeniqua mountains.

name: Sixes Sport & Culture Festival Golf Tournament

priceDetails.cost: Green Fee, Golf Cart, Halfway Meal, Prize Dinner & Festival Tickets

description: Tee off at the championship Kingswood Golf Estate in George for the Sixes Sport & Culture Festival Golf Day (11:00 AM shotgun start). Entry includes your green fee, shared golf cart, halfway house meal, prize-giving dinner, and complimentary festival tickets.

name: Uncle George Christmas Party at the Magical Castle
vibe: Family & Kids, Markets & Community, Live Music & Entertainment
description: A magical Garden Route festive tradition! Bring the whole family to Step Aside Farm in Blanco, George to meet Santa, the Fairy, and all their friends inside an illuminated fairytale castle. Features night-market food stalls, Christmas craft stalls, and brand-new surprises for 2026.

name: Milkwood Village Sunday Market & Live Golden Oldies
vibe: Markets & Community, Live Music & Entertainment, Food & Drink
description: Soak up the laid-back Wilderness village vibe under the ancient Milkwood trees every Sunday! Browse handmade jewellery, art, clothing, and gourmet street food while enjoying live Golden Oldies music surrounded by boutique cafés and restaurants.

name: Midbrak Mark (Opispoor Saturday Market)
description: Midbrak Mark—Alles in EEN! Held every Saturday from 09:00 at Opispoor in Great Brak River. Famous for its Sosatie Stasie (raw or braaied on the spot), traditional syrupy koeksisters, handmade leather Vellies, bromeliads, organic dried mango, local art, and Food Sock meals.

name: Donkey Forest Walks & Rescue Farm Experience
vibe: Nature & Wildlife, Family & Kids, Outdoor & Adventure

priceDetails.cost: From R50 per household / Feed Donation
Bring carrots for the rescue donkeys!

description: A heartwarming hidden gem in Wilderness Heights! Walk alongside friendly rescued donkeys through peaceful forest trails, bottle-feed calves, cuddle twin goat lambs, and meet Judy the cow. All proceeds go directly toward feeding and caring for rescued farm animals.

name: Maple Ranch Adventures: Forest E-Bike Tours & Obstacle Course
vibe: Outdoor & Adventure, Family & Kids, Sports & Fitness
audience: All Ages, Families, Groups, Team Building
description: Unforgettable outdoor adventure on the Garden Route! Maple Ranch offers guided forest tours on both kiddies and adult e-bikes, survivor-style obstacle courses, team-building challenges, and action-packed birthday parties.

name: Kaasklas: Artisanal Cheese-Making Class & Tasting
description: Learn the art and science of crafting your own artisanal cheese at home in this hands-on Mossel Bay workshop hosted by Sumari. Includes step-by-step instruction, starter cultures, tasting, and your own handmade cheese to take home.

name: AV8 Airfield Weekend Breakfast & Sunday Roast Experience

priceDetails.item: Sunday Lamb Rib Roast Lunch (From 1 PM)

location: AV8 Restaurant & Bar, Mossel Bay Airfield, 69 Rooikat St
description: Watch light aircraft and skydivers take off and land right in front of your table at Mossel Bay Airfield! Enjoy the famous R105 Saturday Airfield Breakfast (including cappuccino) or book for the traditional R165 Sunday Lamb Rib Roast with pumpkin fritters and creamy spiced milk tart.
